sources.title: coreai-model-zoo/models/qwen3.5-2b-decision/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: An English typed-decision model: give it a state, a question and declared options to obtain a probability for each option. The source, Jev-Style-Qwen3.5-2B-Decision, merges a LoRA into Qwen3.5-2B-Base and folds its calibration temperature into the final RMSNorm. It retains the tied vocabulary LM head. sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B is a miniature dense Qwen3.5 model — the full gated delta networks architecture, vision encoder, and 262K context, in a form small enough for 8 GB consumer GPUs or edge inference.

sources.title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents
sources.snippet: Compared to Qwen3-VL, Qwen3.5 exhibits more robust performance in scientific problem-solving and other visual reasoning tasks. By integrating image content with contextual understanding, it can carry out multi-step logical reasoning, providing a more dependable foundation for multimodal agents in education, research, and beyond.

sources.title: qwen/qwen3.5-2b • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 2B Qwen3.5 represents a significant leap forward, integrating breakthroughs in multimodal learning, architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility. This is a 2B parameter dense model, supporting a native context length of 262,144 tokens. Highlights Unified Vision-Language Foundation.
